Warehousing

Densité de stockage

A key warehousing KPI measuring the volume of goods stored per unit area or cubic meter in a facility, as reported in inventory audits, WMS dashboards, and warehouse capacity planning documentation.

Quick answer: A key warehousing KPI measuring the volume of goods stored per unit area or cubic meter in a facility, as reported in inventory audits, WMS dashboards, and warehouse capacity planning documentation.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Densité de stockage?

In this glossary, Densité de stockage refers to: A key warehousing KPI measuring the volume of goods stored per unit area or cubic meter in a facility, as reported in inventory audits, WMS dashboards, and warehouse capacity planning documentation.

How is Densité de stockage used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Maximiser la densité de stockage permet à l’entrepôt de stocker plus d’inventaire sans agrandir la surface de l’installation, impactant directement les KPI de capacité."

Why does Densité de stockage matter in logistics?

Densité de stockage matters because it supports clear communication in Warehousing contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Densité de stockage?

Densité de stockage is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does Densité de stockage belong to?

In this glossary, Densité de stockage is grouped under Warehousing. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A key warehousing KPI measuring the volume of goods stored per unit area or cubic meter in a facility, as reported in inventory audits, WMS dashboards, and warehouse capacity planning documentation.

Operational example

Maximizing storage density allows the warehouse to accommodate more inventory without expanding the facility’s footprint, directly impacting capacity KPIs.

Localized term

Densité de stockage

Localized example
